description: This file defines the BindingsController class responsible for managing bindings between global objects and scripts, including adding, removing, and delivering results for bindings.

classes.name: BindingsController
classes.description: Manages script bindings, including adding, removing, and handling binding calls and results.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a new binding to the global object, setting up a function to handle calls.

methods.name: removeBinding
methods.description: Removes a binding from the global object and marks it as removed.

methods.name: takeBindingHandle
methods.description: Retrieves and deletes a handle associated with a binding call.

methods.name: deliverBindingResult
methods.description: Resolves or rejects a promise based on the binding call result.
